    Browsing - Class in org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.playwright
    Runs code that drives a browser against a Server of the harness, in the trace of the server: the code runs in a span, each step is a child span, and every request the browser sends to the server carries the current span, so the server's spans are children of the step that caused them.
    Browsing.BrowserBody<T,E> - Interface in org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.playwright
    Code to run with a browser.
